## Canonical P0-only dependency; replaces premature P4-stacked integration #2596
Base is the current standalone original P0-only [#2595](https://github.com/TrillionniumFoundation/hepta-private-ci/pull/2595) frozen at `f0ca21404ca7497126a3f4ca492669e2b58b66d0`, with exactly the same original FD-bound P0 four source blobs as superseded #2594. No ancestor or file in this branch depends on P4 #2572/#2585; **P0 before P4** is preserved.
Source integration commit `c2479fca39835fdadcb39a8aaebd63e0c11d7966` / tree `a861fe3bc0a5e57a9efda2ed72cce6159a5c01cb`. Current HEAD `6527ffa450124b46c5e982457c00adf88fa8a4dc`, two ordinary non-forced commits on canonical frozen P0, same seven paths. All seven blobs are byte-identical to previous integration #2596 at `117dc67e1cf6296a9074d7adaaa40df7e03ba433`; GitHub original base blob preconditions independently verified before transplantation.

## Exact original owner/CNS integration
* Original post-effect failures now return `Ambiguous` after durable Prepare, preserving the one-time idempotency key, no repeated Execute, and the canonical P0 fsynced metadata from same write FD (#2586).
* Read back the same local frozen plan, signed-owner trust pins and inode-bound frame instances after final potentially slow external negative and NDU/Selector callbacks, not just before them (#2587).
* Exact four source blobs from signed original CNS #2592 `9b07fbfbbfb653829bfd3b2fe6cb24d3a7745466`: require independently durable CNS sequence **equal** to signed original cutover sequence, recheck after signed live route RPC, with tests for historical correctly signed receipt and mid-readback advanced durable revision.
* Three additional original-owner native adversarial regressions, **64** `#[test]` declarations total, Rust locked Architecture minimum gate 64 plus three source-head focused native receipts. Original P0 and upstream gates retained.

## Exact hosted Rustfmt repair and upstream ancestry update (2026-10-17)
The original standalone #2595 source-head [Architecture run 39003309557](https://github.com/TrillionniumFoundation/hepta-private-ci/actions/runs/39003309557) failed at Rustfmt after passing early Cargo resolution/canary. This branch has now applied the **same six exact runner-format diffs** to its integrated owner and test files in non-forced commit `03c66a2dfafbbb1c7db526a083cb13091c4db420`. The two corrections change source formatting only; no owner authorization, receipt bytes or initial P0 feature changes. **Current exact HEAD is that new SHA**, and its own native source-head/merge/global CI must finish.

#2595 independently advanced additively to `f1bc6cf66f0296d3f625d790f7d867ee62ba0fe3` with identical logged formatter corrections, while this branch still retains original ancestral P0 `f0ca21404ca7497126a3f4ca492669e2b58b66d0`. This is a temporary Git ancestry divergence, not a permission to inherit upstream PASS; prospective merge and exact source identity must be revalidated and the entire chain remains DRAFT / DENY_ALL. The real non-test Agentd callback-only advance and physical CNS publish_once gates remain blocked, so none of these test-mode native fixtures can grant a physical cutover.

## Nonwaivable no-go
A source file/commit SHA, mock sig or synthetically captured matrix is not a production effect/readback. Source-only preservation is verified. This HEAD still awaits actual native Cargo/fmt/Clippy/Architecture/global blocking CI. Original same-Control durable Begin→deployed production CNS cutover + independently signed live readback→Commit, separate Final-use issuer, Supervisor crash/power-loss recovery, prospective frozen NDU no-change baseline/negative transfer, and 16 target-host workload receipts with independent observer still do not have release proof here.
**DRAFT / DENY_ALL / NO MAIN MERGE / NO PHYSICAL CELL SPLIT / NO MODEL PROMOTION.**

## Exact-head CNS CI receipt ratchet (follow-up)
At current HEAD `6527ffa450124b46c5e982457c00adf88fa8a4dc`, the existing Architecture workflow now requires **14 original cutover tests and 11 original CNS runtime port tests**, not a one-test smoke allowance. It also runs three new source-head focused native tests: old correctly signed CNS receipt after durable frontier advancement, advancement during signed route RPC, and direct runtime stale-commit refusal. These are mandatory execution commands **pending real GitHub Actions results**; fixture tests and GitHub source checks do not authorize physical split.


## Canonical P0 strict ancestry convergence (2026-10-17)
Latest **no-content-drift** integration HEAD: `a56b31dc6cb8e735f5f4df9f010708ffa25f554a`, a two-parent *ordinary* merge commit over the exact source-formatted integration `03c66a2dfafbbb1c7db526a083cb13091c4db420` and updated canonical P0 parent `f1bc6cf66f0296d3f625d790f7d867ee62ba0fe3`. The merge tree is **identical** to the preceding source-formatted integration tree `6063b10ffaf4903222bed8696cd63dad2e1481b0`; no test, workflow, signed receipt or permission bytes changed. GitHub compare against the updated canonical P0 confirms **ahead 4, behind 0**, seven original source/test/workflow paths. The prior temporary ancestry divergence is resolved without force-push or P4 inheritance. This new exact commit HEAD still needs its own source-head/merge-base Cargo/fmt/Clippy, global blocking/security and independent production proof. Nothing in this source-only merge authorizes a physical cutover.


## 2026-10-17 P0 source-head repair and orphan WAL diagnostic
Current canonical P0 integration HEAD **`7c3e946878496642bfc30f7956e6f8e6d855ee9a`** with latest canonical P0 base `a687cff3ba7d75c0b0da1c77045ca0763f0b2ac9` (GitHub ahead 8, behind 0). Hosted [Architecture run 39007462469](https://github.com/TrillionniumFoundation/hepta-private-ci/actions/runs/39007462469) confirmed base-merge PASS but source-head Rustfmt FAILURE: exactly five original diffs across the CNS cutover test, final-callback/Commit test, and CNS runtime test. Applied those exact five printed hunks via ordinary commits `b962e27`, `dbbba6a`, `c91bdf5` (no production permissions/receipt semantics altered). Separately, upstream [Architecture 39007312850](https://github.com/TrillionniumFoundation/hepta-private-ci/actions/runs/39007312850) ran 30 original NDU publication tests and failed **1** assertion: unresolved fsynced Begin cold restart must remain `Indeterminate`. Added strict diagnostic that still requires exactly that variant, checks original 2-row WAL, and records true mismatched error without bypass; added an earlier native exact-Cargo receipt on original canonical P0 via `a687cff`, integrated as two-parent ordinary commit `7c3e946878496642bfc30f7956e6f8e6d855ee9a`. The final merge is P0-only; P4 #2572/#2585 remains separate. Latest exact-head CI is **NOT** yet PASS, and no real production B→physical signed CNS effect→C/Final-use/Supervisor/power-loss/target-host authorization is claimed. DRAFT / DENY_ALL.


## 2026-10-17 exact native P0 post-effect inode regression repair
- On prior exact head `7c3e946878496642bfc30f7956e6f8e6d855ee9a`, [Architecture run 39015450609](https://github.com/TrillionniumFoundation/hepta-private-ci/actions/runs/39015450609) had **source-head FAILURE** on the early actual native `byte_identical_frame_replacement_` suite: **2 PASS / 1 FAIL**, while the real CAS re-open test passed and base-merge Job succeeded.
- The failing original test `byte_identical_frame_replacement_during_effect_never_acknowledges_or_reexecutes` expected `Invalid("original local split frame identity changed")` after the original external effect already executed, but the integrated #2586 owner deliberately and correctly maps a post-effect local ledger/readback failure to `Ambiguous` to preserve the one idempotency key. Relaxing the production error mapping would reopen the duplicate Execute risk.
- **Current HEAD `3f058cbe8ee6424b9ba944fce113de973f0feede`** changes *only* this exact test expectation to `Ambiguous`, with explicit same-effect/no-reexecute explanation. It retains 64 owner tests, the post-Prepare fsynced pending frame, no local committed frame, exactly one original external Execute and all other original inode/read-only/recovery regression expectations. No owner code, signer, Final-use, CNS, CI threshold, Cargo, dependency or permissions changed.
- This is a **targeted source correction**, **NOT a new native PASS**. On current SHA require exact source-head/base-merge locked Cargo + strict Clippy and global security workflows. Physical effects and model promotion remain `DENY_ALL`.


## Strict exact-source format and qualification continuation (2026-10-17)
Previous exact head `3f058cbe8ee6424b9ba944fce113de973f0feede`: original [Architecture 39018858653](https://github.com/TrillionniumFoundation/hepta-private-ci/actions/runs/39018858653) **source-head PASS** and **base-merge PASS**, actual 64-owner and signed CNS/Supervisor checks executed; V8 canary PASS. Its [blocking-ci 39018858811](https://github.com/TrillionniumFoundation/hepta-private-ci/actions/runs/39018858811) also confirmed real **Ruff, Bazel lockfile and cargo-deny** failures, with RustSec 2026-0318/0319, 2024-0449 and 2026-0367/0368/0369. Current ordinary two-parent HEAD `903045190798ba2adfec0a5a12243cd97fb9578c` incorporates the upstream P0 **two exact Ruff edits** with no state machine or signer changes, compare ahead 10/behind 0. The original PASS is for the prior SHA only; current native and global CI must be rerun. No advisory ignores, no lockfile bypass; original same-Control signed production activation remains denied.
**DRAFT / DENY_ALL / no main merge, physical split or model promotion.**


## 2026-10-17 original Control WAL process-exit/SIGKILL lock qualification

- The prior exact head `903045190798ba2adfec0a5a12243cd97fb9578c` had **source-head failure, base-merge PASS**, from real [Architecture #39024704964](https://github.com/TrillionniumFoundation/hepta-private-ci/actions/runs/39024704964). Its actual Unix/Cargo `ndu_publication` suite ran **30 native tests**: 29 PASS, 1 FAIL. `missing_or_unbounded_original_cns_receipt_never_commits_control_handoff` observed `WriterUnavailable` rather than the strictly required `Indeterminate` on a cold replay after the previous owner was dropped. No activation or Control Commit was accepted.
- This suite also contains real subprocess `abrupt_process_exit_after_control_begin_fences_recovery` and `sigkill_after_control_begin_without_commit_keeps_original_wal_quarantined` tests; when the Rust test harness executes all cases in parallel, fork-before-CLOEXEC can transiently inherit OFD/file locks. This is a **plausible concurrency explanation, not proven root cause**. Changing a real lock error to `Indeterminate` or retrying the cutover without original evidence would conceal the issue.
- Source-only CI patch commits `ac79f72248abcff50d911da06263f4c55ff0cb5f` and `91a662a1921aaaef794c33df61442494bb9c0b32` retain the **same original 30 native `ndu_publication` cases and exact orphan assertions**, but run the collective suite with `--test-threads=1` and enforce `--minimum-tests 30`. A source-scope regression asserts these exact arguments remain on the same original owner gate. Separate process-exit and actual SIGKILL tests and all prior CI remain mandatory and unskipped.
- No Control logic, filesystem lock mapping, original WAL, CAS/CNS runtime, signer, Final-use, Supervisor, cargo dependencies, branch protection or production authority modified. No evidence fabricated; CI results from the earlier failing SHA are preserved. The exact new HEAD is `91a662a1921aaaef794c33df61442494bb9c0b32`; **do not mark PASS until fresh exact source-head/base-merge plus global blocking-ci finish**.

**DRAFT / DENY_ALL / NO PHYSICAL CELL SPLIT / NO MAIN MERGE.**


### Exact canonical P0 source update
The scope assertion was further formatted as a bounded single-line Python comprehension in ordinary commit `91a662a1921aaaef794c33df61442494bb9c0b32`, with the **unchanged** locked native original-Control suite (`--minimum-tests 30 --test-threads=1`). No runtime/CNS/Control B/C or signing code changed. [New Architecture](https://github.com/TrillionniumFoundation/hepta-private-ci/actions/runs/39039181604) was superseded by a new exact-sha qualification run; neither is a success receipt for `91a662a1921aaaef794c33df61442494bb9c0b32` until it finishes.

+# P0 canonical original-owner post-effect Selector/NDU fence
+
+**Scope:** unmerged draft extension of the original 4-effect, single-writer, FD-pinned
+`CellSplitExecutionOwnerV1` from PR #2597 at `903045190798ba2adfec0a5a12243cd97fb9578c`.
+This adds no new physical execution service or independent authority.
+
+The original coordinator already checks independently admitted selection twice
+before the fsynced Prepare and rejects stale, tampered and unauthenticated
+original effect receipts. Its last predecessor readback can be followed by a
+long-running native CAS/migration/CNS/Supervisor effect. A selection may be
+withdrawn while that effect is committing. Before this change the local
+coordinator could append the `committed` frame after that revocation.
+
+After a real native effect and signed current-owner readback, the coordinator now:
+
+1. Revalidates the original, immutable local ledger and native predecessor
+   receipts.
+2. Queries current Selector/NDU admission again; denial is **Ambiguous**
+   because the native effect may have committed, not a safe negative Execute.
+3. Revalidates the original locked plan, keys, prepared intent and prefix after
+   the admission callback. If anything changed, leave Prepare unresolved.
+4. Only then attempts fsynced, create-only local Commit.
+
+When either post-effect gate rejects, cold recovery reopens the same exact
+prepared intent and read-only reconciles with the original signed effect.
+It never dispatches another Execute for that idempotency key. Tests cover all
+four real-operation stages with fixture native signers, native-readback-triggered
+revocation, and local post-callback trust substitution.
+
+**Not a physical transaction:** this is a coordinator ACK fence, not an
+atomic distributed Final-use grant, remote generation fence, native CAS/CNS
+commit, independently stored rollback floor or independent observer. The
+external owner must separately enforce Final-use at the actual effect boundary.
+The native test signers are fixtures and are not production issuance.
+
+**Exact-source qualification required:**
+```bash
+cd codex-rs
+cargo test --locked -p codex-hepta-operator-acceptance --lib post_effect_
+cargo test --locked -p codex-hepta-operator-acceptance --lib selector_withdrawal_during_post_effect_
+cargo fmt --all -- --check
+cargo clippy --locked -p codex-hepta-operator-acceptance --all-targets -- -D warnings
+```
+
+Keep DRAFT / DENY_ALL until the canonical P0 source-head and merge tests,
+B4, global blocking CI, independently signed original effects and target-host
+crash/power-loss gates all succeed. Do **not** merge or activate the separate
+Supervisor readback seam in #2621/#2663 as a second production executor.
+
+## Canonical Control ancestry and final operator readback
+
+The original canonical Control WAL orphan inspector branch PR #2642
+(`f4a688592a0102f82dfe086b2b2c9f7c5224e89f`) is adopted as a **second Git parent** of the
+post-effect fix. The merge retains the same original Supervisor/CNS/Artifact
+owners and the independent immutable Control actor; its orphan-`Begin`
+readback remains **read-only** and cannot invent Control Commit, unfreeze a
+physical owner, or authorize a new Execute.
+
+The legacy operator CLI was also hardened: a four-owner `verified_complete`
+readback is not permission to return `complete=true` if the current NDU
+selection was withdrawn during that last RPC. The final status callback is
+read-only, has no promotion authority and cannot replace native Final-use.
+Transcript-mode output is historical, `production_activation_authorized=false`.
+Both the original execution-owner and CLI code remain blocked from production
+physical CellSplit.
+
+Added a focused `post_readback_selection_withdrawal_cannot_report_completed_split`
+regression and updated exact-head expectations. The Control orphan inspector
+tests observed green at the original #2642 SHA do not automatically qualify
+this merged source SHA.
+
+## Current original-owner evidence after NDU callbacks
+
+After the first successful, signed native effect readback, the independent
+Selector/NDU callback can block long enough for the **same** original native
+effect owner to withdraw or replace that previously verified effect. The
+coordinator now performs another read-only original-effect
+`verify_committed(intent, receipt)` after this callback. If it fails, the
+previously fsynced `Prepared` remains ambiguous, with no second Execute.
+After that live native readback, a fourth current NDU/Selector check guards
+withdrawal during the additional RPC. The exact locked local ledger and
+signer pins are revalidated after each slow callback.
+
+Two more native fixture regressions cover loss of the original effect at all
+four stages and NDU withdrawal during the second signed owner readback.
+The Architecture workflow explicitly runs them as separate `--minimum-tests 1`
+records, and its scope regression enforces those records. They are not
+production-issuer proofs and cannot close the residual cross-service atomic
+Final-use gap.
